desc: Develop and validate an exact convolution implementation suitable for Python at the \(10^6\) value bound.
Derive and verify that \((\operatorname{conv}[2B]-1)/2\) counts each fine triplet exactly once.
Build the indicator representation and parse input efficiently within memory limits.
Aggregate over present middle values and handle \(N<3\), missing values, and boundary indices.
Run the resulting implementation against all provided samples and confirm exact outputs.
